By Data Skrive ,
2 hours ago
The Milwaukee Brewers will be hosting the Los Angeles Dodgers for a three-game series, with the first matchup getting underway at 7:40 p.m. ET on Friday, May 22.
Brewers vs. Dodgers Series Info Dodgers @ Brewers Time: Friday, May 22 at 7:40 p.m. ET Brewers Starting Pitcher: Logan Henderson Dodgers Starting Pitcher: Justin Wrobleski TV Channel : Brewers.TV and SportsNet LA Livestream: Fubo Dodgers @ Brewers Time: Saturday, May 23 at 7:15 p.m. ET Brewers Starting Pitcher: Robert Gasser Dodgers Starting Pitcher: Roki Sasaki TV Channel : FOX Livestream: Fubo Dodgers @ Brewers Time: Sunday, May 24 at 2:10 p.m. ET Brewers Starting Pitcher: Brandon Sproat Dodgers Starting Pitcher: Yoshinobu Yamamoto TV Channel : Brewers.TV and SportsNet LA Livestream: Fubo How to Bet on Brewers vs. Dodgers Games Brewers vs. Dodgers Betting Insights The Brewers are 18-11 in games they were listed as the moneyline favorite (winning 62.1% of those games). Milwaukee has won eight, or 61.5%, of the 13 games it has played as the underdog this season. The Dodgers have put together a 29-19 record in games they were listed as the moneyline favorite (winning 60.4% of those games). Los Angeles has not played a game this season while listed as the underdog.
